purpose: Teach: 踏み出す/言い換える/照らす/仕え/出くわし/入り込む/病ん/すすん

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんが新しい道に踏み出すって仰ったわ
lines.en: Sho, your dad said he was taking a step forward in a new direction.
lines.style: Warm, matter-of-fact delivery. Settling into a memory she's about to share with him. Slight pause after his name. Speaking as a mother who observes her husband's small choices.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、難しい言葉、お父さんは易しく言い換える名人だよ
lines.en: Mom, Dad's really good at taking hard words and putting them in a way I can understand.
lines.style: Quiet observation, almost to himself. No performance. A small, genuine realization delivered without needing confirmation. Slight lift at the end — noticing something true.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんがお部屋を懐中電灯で照らす遊びをして下さったわ
lines.en: Sho, your dad played this game with me where he'd shine his flashlight around the room.
lines.style: Soft, remembering tone. Almost dreamy. Pauses slightly before 'flashlight' — she's picturing it. Warm without being sentimental. The pleasure of recalling a small, ordinary kindness.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、お父さんが先輩に仕える礼儀を教えて下さったよ
lines.en: Mom, Dad taught me how to show respect to people who came before me.
lines.style: Thoughtful, measured. Not bragging — just stating something he's understood. The voice of a child who takes things seriously. Slight emphasis on 'respect' — he knows it mattered.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんと公園で意外なお客様に出くわしたわ
lines.en: Sho, your dad and I ran into someone unexpected at the park the other day.
lines.style: Gentle surprise in the opening. Paced slowly, as if she's drawing him into the memory. Slightly curious tone — she wants to see if he'll guess who. Composed but present.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、絵本に入り込むみたいに集中して読んだよ
lines.en: Mom, I read this picture book and I got so caught up in it I didn't notice anything else around me.
lines.style: Eager but not loud. The pride of absorption — of being fully inside something. Quick pace, then a slight catch of breath at the end. The voice of a child who wants her to know he was really there.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんが風邪で病んでらしたから労って差し上げてね
lines.en: Sho, your dad's been under the weather, so be gentle with him, will you?
lines.style: Gentle instruction, not a command. Slight softness on 'under the weather' — she's protecting him from worry while being honest. A mother's quiet way of asking for his care. Pace is easy, expectant.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、お父さんと一緒にもっと前にすすんでいくよ
lines.en: Mom, I'm going to keep moving forward with Dad, step by step.
lines.style: Soft resolve. Not dramatic — just steady certainty. The voice of a child making a quiet promise. Slight emphasis on 'with Dad' — he's not alone in this. Warm close, trailing gently into silence.
